name: Integrated Programme for Older Persons
department: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
target_group: Older persons needing institutional and community support
eligibility: Services are provided through eligible organisations/projects approved under the programme.
benefits: Support for old-age homes, day-care centres, mobile medicare units and other services for older persons.
application_process: Access services through approved implementing organisations or the concerned social justice department.
source: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Government of India
